summary: The table presents a financial performance summary comparing key metrics for the periods ending September 30, 2024, September 30, 2023, and June 30, 2024. It includes revenues, cost of sales, gross profit, operating expenses, and net profit, along with growth percentages year-over-year (YoY) and quarter-over-quarter (QoQ). Notable insights include a 5.1% YoY growth in revenues from 2023 to 2024 and a 4.2% QoQ growth from June to September 2024. The net profit after minority interest shows a 4.7% YoY increase. The table also details earnings per share (EPS) and dividend per share, highlighting financial growth and profitability trends.
